name: kio-sbs-bk
description: KIO SBS — 2 Workers Express + GraphQL sobre Cloudflare D1 (api + sync)

scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && (npm run dev:api & npm run dev:sync & wait)
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply kio-sbs --local -c wrangler.api.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply kio-sbs --remote -c wrangler.api.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:sync
